gear: Two ice tools — sustained thin ice up to roughly WI4/95° through the main couloir
4-5 ice screws — placements are marginal through much of the ice, so don't plan on a dense rack
A few thin pitons (blades) for shale seams on the mixed third step, where the route exits the ice onto rock
Small cams and nuts (to ~2") for the same mixed rock section
1-2 snow flukes for anchors in unconsolidated spindrift/snow sections
V-thread tool and cord for ice rappel anchors on the descent
Helmet — the couloir is a spindrift and rockfall funnel
